name: Line Following out of Bounds
hint: A line-follower comparison with a state outside 0, 1, 2, or 3 cannot match a sensor state, making the branch impossible.
instruction: Handle only the four supported line-follower states 0, 1, 2, and 3, and validate any state value before comparing it.

examples.label: Error
examples.scratchblocks:
when green flag clicked
if <(@mBot line follower sensor [port2 v] value :: sensing) = (4)> then
say [Invalid line state]
end
